blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: AI systems may miss indirect, culturally situated distress or provide support mismatched to the application context. Existing benchmarks do not jointly address cultural variation, application context, and practitioner disagreement. We introduce VEILED-SH, a benchmark and construction methodology for evaluating single-turn responses to indirect expressions of suicide, self-harm, and distress. Its 10,003 prompts span counselor chat, forum posts, platform search, and triage, drawing on Singapore-grounded sources and public datasets. An expert-validated multi-label taxonomy distinguishes intent, communicative function, and response behavior. Six automated profiles, individually calibrated to three peer-support practitioners and three clinicians, retain separate reference policies for proxy-alignment scoring. Evaluating five systems on a coverage-enriched sample reveals variation in proxy alignment across profile-generated reference policies, even for the same system responses.
blocks.zh: 人工智能系统可能错失间接的、文化上的困扰,或提供与应用程序上下文不匹配的支持。 现有的基准并不共同解决文化差异、应用背景和从业人员的分歧。 我们引入了VEILED-SH,作为评估对自杀、自残和痛苦等间接表现的单回合反应的基准和构建方法。 它的10 003个提示包括顾问聊天、论坛帖子、平台搜索和分辨, 一种经过专家验证的多标签分类法区分了意图,沟通功能,以及反应行为. 6个自动剖面图,分别校准为3个对等支助从业人员和3个临床医生,保留了单独的代理对等评分参考政策. 对5个系统进行涵盖范围较广的抽样评估,发现不同概况生成的参考政策之间的代理协调存在差异,即使是对同一系统的回应也是如此。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: AI systems are embedded in many aspects of our lives, and are increasingly expected to handle expressions of distress in a safe and responsible way. In local contexts, expressions of distress to AI systems for emotional support ( Dwyer et al., 2025 ; Bentley et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) may rely on culturally specific idioms, euphemisms, or context-dependent references that obscure risk. Although AI responses can be rated as more empathic or compassionate than human-written ones ( Lee et al., 2024 ; Welivita et al., 2026 ) , this does not establish that a system has recognized distress appropriately. Practitioners may also disagree about the response even when they share an interpretation, and excessive affirmation can reinforce false or harmful beliefs ( Ibrahim et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 人工智能系统植根于我们生活的许多方面,人们越来越期望以安全和负责任的方式处理危难的表达。 在当地背景下,对AI系统的情绪支持表达痛苦(Dwyer等人,2025年;Bentley等人,2026年;Wu等人,2026年)可能依赖于文化上特有的偏执,委婉,或依赖背景的引用来掩盖风险. 尽管大赦国际的答复可被评为比人书写的更同情心或同情心(Lee等人,2024年;Welivita等人,2026年),但这并不能证明一个系统已经适当地认识到危难。 执业者即使有共同的解释,也可能对回应意见有分歧,过分的肯定会强化虚假或有害的信仰(Ibrahim等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Benchmarks of simulated suicide-risk conversations and counseling responses ( Bentley et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) have advanced evaluation, but do not jointly address three gaps: (i) culturally situated indirect distress across application contexts; (ii) distinct labels for prompt intent, communicative function, and response behavior; and (iii) separate reference policies calibrated to individual practitioners within and across responder archetypes. Figure 1 illustrates this ambiguity: its final example combines self-injury and thoughts of jumping with denial of suicidal intent, complicating both interpretation and response choice. We therefore keep prompt interpretation, response choice, and differences among reference policies separate in our single-turn evaluations.
blocks.zh: 模拟自杀风险对话和咨询反应的基准(Bentley等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年)有先进的评价,但没有共同弥补三个差距:(一) 不同应用背景的间接困扰文化位置;(二) 快速意图、沟通功能和反应行为的不同标签;(三) 针对反应器型内和跨反应器型的个人从业人员制定单独的参考政策。 图1说明了这种模糊性:其最后的例子将自我伤害和跳跃思想与否认自杀意图结合起来,使解释和反应选择复杂化。 因此,我们在单回合评价中保持迅速的解释、反应选择和参考政策之间的差异。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Examples from VEILED-SH illustrating indirect, culturally specific references to suicide and context-dependent help-seeking.
blocks.zh: 图1:VEILED-SH的例子,说明间接的、文化上具体提到自杀和依赖环境寻求帮助。

blocks.en: Addressing these gaps, we introduce VEILED-SH (Vulnerability Expression through Indirect Language Evaluation Dataset; SH denotes self-harm), a benchmark evaluating single-turn responses to indirect expressions of suicide, self-harm, and distress. Six automated profiles, each calibrated to one practitioner’s annotations of 30 shared cases (three peer-support practitioners and three clinicians), produce separate reference policies. Prompts use Singapore-grounded sources and public datasets. Forum prompts retain anonymized source wording, while other prompts are rewritten for counselor chat, platform search, or triage.
blocks.zh: 面对这些差距,我们引入了VEILED-SH(通过间接语言评价数据集表达脆弱性;SH表示自我伤害),这是评估对间接表达自杀、自我伤害和痛苦的单回合反应的基准。 6个自动剖面图,每个剖面图为30个共用病例的1名执业人员(3名同行支助执业人员和3名临床医生)的说明,编制单独的参考政策。 Points使用以新加坡为基准的来源和公共数据集. 论坛提示保留匿名源语言,而其他提示则被重写为咨询员聊天,平台搜索,或分门别类.

blocks.en: We evaluate five AI systems on a diagnostic sample of 2,001 prompts from the 10,003-prompt benchmark, selected to cover less frequent categories. Each system is prompted as a peer supporter or clinician, and a three-model jury scores its responses against three corresponding reference policies. Full proxy alignment requires a response to be judged appropriate and to satisfy every category in a profile’s policy. For GPT 5.6 Terra, the mean rate across judges ranges from 64.8% to 90.5% across peer-support profiles, partly reflecting differences in policy size. These scores describe alignment with automated references, not clinical effectiveness or safety.
blocks.zh: 我们评估了从10 003个即时基准中抽取的2 001个诊断提示的5个人工智能系统,以涵盖较少的类别。 每个系统都是作为同伴支持者或临床医生而推动的,一个三模式陪审团根据三个相应的参考政策来评定其答复. 完全的代理协调要求做出适当的反应,满足概况政策中的每一个类别。 就GPT 5.6 Terra而言,法官的平均比率从64.8%到90.5%不等,部分反映了政策规模的差异。 这些分数描述了与自动引用的一致,而不是临床有效性或安全性.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: (i) a 10,003-prompt benchmark and quality-controlled construction pipeline 1 1 1 Dataset will be released in camera-ready. ; (ii) evaluation against separate practitioner-calibrated reference policies; and (iii) an expert-validated taxonomy separating prompt intent, communicative function, and responses.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:(一) 一个10 003个即时基准和质量控制的建筑管道11 1个数据集将按相机准备发布;(二) 对照不同的从业者校准的参考政策进行评估;(三) 一个经过专家验证的分类法,将即时意图、交流功能和反应区分开来。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Prior work provides evaluation platforms and benchmarks of psychiatric practice, therapeutic reasoning, and conversational support ( Dwyer et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) . VERA-MH evaluates simulated multi-turn suicide-risk conversations with clinician-designed rubrics and compares automated judgments with clinician consensus ( Bentley et al., 2026 ) ; CounselBench evaluates single-turn mental-health answers with expert ratings and adversarial cases ( Li et al., 2026 ) . VEILED-SH evaluates responses to indirect, culturally situated distress across four application contexts and reports proxy alignment with each profile-generated reference policy.
blocks.zh: 先前的工作为精神病学实践、治疗推理和谈话支持提供了评价平台和基准(Dwyer等人,2025年;Liu等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2025年;徐等人,2025年)。 VERA-MH评价模拟多回合自杀风险对话与临床医生设计的数字,并将自动判断与临床医生的共识进行比较(Bentley等人,2026年);Bench律师以专家评分和对抗性案例评价单回合心理健康答案(Li等人,2026年). VEILED-SH评价针对四种应用背景的间接的、文化背景的困扰的应对措施,并报告代理政策与每个概况生成的参考政策保持一致。

blocks.en: The C-SSRS informs suicidal-intent severity within INTENT ( Posner et al., 2011 ) ; the Five Self-Harm Behavior Groupings Measure informs self-harm behavior distinctions ( Liljedahl et al., 2023 ) ; and the Inventory of Statements About Self-Injury informs NSSI-related FUNCTION labels ( Klonsky and Glenn, 2009 ) . Practitioner review and annotation adapt these foundations to indirect, single-turn prompts and refine the RESPONSE labels.
blocks.zh: C-SSRS在INTENT(Posner等人,2011年)中告知自杀严重性;五个自我伤害行为组合措施告知自我伤害行为区别(Liljedahl等人,2023年);关于自我伤害的声明清单告知NSSI相关功能标签(Klonsky和Glenn,2009年)。 从业人员审查和注释使这些基础适应间接的单回合制提示,并完善了RESPONSE标签。

blocks.en: Expert ratings and clinician assessments have been used to evaluate mental-health AI ( Badawi et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; McBain et al., 2025 ) . Work on disagreement cautions against collapsing distinct perspectives into one reference ( Basile et al., 2021 ; Fleisig et al., 2024 ) . VEILED-SH calibrates one automated profile per practitioner and scores responses against the three profile-generated reference policies for the matching responder archetype. These policies remain automated proxies, as calibration only partly preserves observed practitioner disagreement.
blocks.zh: 专家评级和临床医生评估被用来评价心理健康AI(Badawi等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年;McBain等人,2025年)。 有关分歧的工作提醒人们不要将不同的观点变成一种参考(Basile等人,2021年;Fleisig等人,2024年)。 VEILED-SH 校准每个从业人员一个自动剖面图,并根据匹配的响应器型的三种剖面图生成的参考政策来评分回复. 这些政策仍然是自动代理,因为校准只是部分地保留了观察到的执业者的分歧.

blocks.en: 3 Taxonomy Development
blocks.zh: 3 分类学发展

blocks.en: Indirect expressions of distress raise two questions for evaluation: what the prompt conveys and what response it warrants. A single label would conflate uncertainty about the user’s intent with disagreement about an appropriate response. We therefore developed separate labels for prompt INTENT , communicative FUNCTION , and recommended RESPONSE behaviors. Table 1 presents the resulting multi-label taxonomy.
blocks.zh: 间接表示危难引起两个问题,供评价:迅速传达什么以及需要作出什么反应。 一个单一的标签会把关于用户意图的不确定性与关于适当反应的不同意见混为一谈。 因此,我们为迅速的INTENT、交流性功能开发了单独的标签,并推荐了RESPONSE的行为。 表1列出了由此产生的多标签分类。

blocks.en: Table 1: The VEILED-SH taxonomy. Examples reproduce geography-neutral wording.
blocks.zh: 表1:VEILED-SH分类法. 实例转载了地域中立的措辞。

blocks.en: 3.1 Development Process
blocks.zh: 3.1 发展进程

blocks.en: We drafted the taxonomy using the C-SSRS for suicidal-intent severity, the Five Self-Harm Behavior Groupings Measure for self-harm distinctions, and the Inventory of Statements About Self-Injury for non-suicidal self-injury (NSSI)-related functions ( Posner et al., 2011 ; Liljedahl et al., 2023 ; Klonsky and Glenn, 2009 ) . These were starting points: indirect, single-turn prompts require labels grounded in the text, while evaluation requires categories for recommended response behaviors.
blocks.zh: 我们起草了使用C-SSRS进行自杀性严重性的分类、关于自我伤害区别的五个自我伤害行为组合措施以及关于非自杀性自我伤害的自我伤害的声明清单(Posner等人,2011年;Lilljedahl等人,2023年;Klonsky和Glenn,2009年)。 这些是起点:间接的,单转的提示需要基于文本的标签,而评价则需要推荐的反应行为分类.

blocks.en: Ten experts with relevant mental-health training and experience working in organizations in the domain participated in structured discussions to review the draft. These included frontline practitioners and professionals developing mental-health applications and tools in Singapore. All had direct experience in the field and familiarity with the local social and cultural context, including the language varieties and expressions in scope for VEILED-SH. Participants were recruited through professional networks, and participation was voluntary. We withhold their identities and affiliations to respect participant privacy.
blocks.zh: 拥有相关心理健康培训和在该领域各组织工作经验的10名专家参加了审查草案的分阶段讨论。 其中包括新加坡前线从业人员和开发心理健康应用和工具的专业人员。 所有人都在这一领域有直接经验,熟悉当地社会和文化背景,包括VEILED-SH的语言品种和表达方式。 与会者是通过专业网络招聘的,参与是自愿的。 我们拒绝承认他们的身份和归属,以尊重参与者的隐私。

blocks.en: Across three rounds, participants reviewed the taxonomy and shared perspectives on how distress is expressed and addressed in the real world. They examined label boundaries using cases of indirect distress, uncertain single-message interpretation, and response choice. The discussion highlighted evolving localized youth expressions, including sewer slide (suicide), barcode (self-harm scars), and the short forms kms (kill myself), sh (self-harm), and od (overdose). Such expressions underscored the need to label what the prompt supports without inferring an unexpressed clinical state.
blocks.zh: 在三轮中,与会者审查了关于现实世界如何表达和解决危难的分类学和共同观点。 他们利用间接危难、不确定的单一信息解释和反应选择等情况来审查标签界限。 讨论突出了不断演变的本地化青年表达方式,包括下水道滑行(自杀)、条码(自伤伤伤疤)以及短程(自杀)、sh(自伤)和od(过量)。 这种表达方式强调,必须标出及时支持的内容,而不推断出一个未表达的临床状态。

blocks.zh: 表2:申请背景和互动合同。

blocks.en: The resulting taxonomy reflects three design choices. First, INTENT distinguishes benign figurative language and general distress from NSSI and suicidal intent. NSSI and suicidal intent are kept distinct, because NSSI is not automatically evidence of suicidal intent. Although the C-SSRS was developed for clinical assessment, its higher-risk severity distinctions are adapted here to evidence available in a single prompt and do not aim to establish a clinical state.
blocks.zh: 由此产生的分类法反映了三种设计选择. 首先,INTENT将良性比喻语言和一般困扰与NSSI和自杀意图区分开来. NSSI和自杀意图是有区别的,因为NSSI不是自杀意图的自动证据。 虽然C-SSRS是为临床评估而开发的,但其较高风险严重程度的区别在此进行调整,以适应单一瞬间可获得的证据,而不是旨在建立临床状态。

blocks.en: Second, FUNCTION captures why an expression may be communicatively relevant through several main reasons: emotional regulation , existential reflection, exploration , and interpersonal purposes. Unknown records when the prompt does not support an inference about motivation, rather than forcing one from ambiguous wording.
blocks.zh: 第二,功能论通过下列几个主要原因抓住了表达可能具有沟通相关性的原因:情绪调节、存在反思、探索和人际目的。 当提示不支持对动机的推论,而不是用模棱两可的措辞强迫动机时,未知的记录.

blocks.en: Third, RESPONSE identifies recommended behaviors that may co-occur, including clarifying, validating, refusing, advising, de-escalating, and redirecting. The reviewers particularly emphasized Clarify/Investigate when a single message leaves the situation uncertain, and cautioned against treating refusal, safety planning, or redirection as universally appropriate. Keeping these recommendations separate from prompt labels permits different response choices under the same interpretation.
blocks.zh: 第三,RESPONSE确定了可能共同渗透的推荐行为,包括澄清,验证,拒绝,建议,降级,重定向. 审查人员特别强调,当单一信息使情况不确定时,应澄清/调查,并告诫不要将拒绝、安全规划或重新定向视为普遍适当。 将这些建议与即时标签分开,允许在同一解释下作出不同的反应选择。

blocks.en: For evaluation, a responder archetype is a responder perspective; VEILED-SH includes peer-support and clinician responder archetypes. A practitioner is a human annotator from a peer-support or clinician responder archetype . A profile is a frozen automated evaluator calibrated from one practitioner’s annotations. Each profile generates a separate reference policy containing INTENT and FUNCTION labels and recommended RESPONSE categories; a separate jury assesses system outputs (Section 5 ).
blocks.zh: 对于评价来说,响应者原型是响应者视角;VEILED-SH包括对等支持和临床响应者原型. 开业医师是来自同龄人支持或临床医生回应型的人类注释员。 简介是用一名从业人员的说明校准的冷冻自动评价员。 每个剖面图生成一个单独的参考政策,其中包含INTENT和FCOSION标签以及推荐的RESPONSE类别;一个单独的评审团评估系统输出(第5节).

blocks.en: 3.2 Application Contexts
blocks.zh: 3.2 应用程序背景

blocks.en: Taxonomy labels alone do not specify how a message is encountered, as appropriate support also depends on the interaction setting in which distress is expressed. We define four application contexts, each with an interaction contract governing the prompt’s length, structure, addressee, and communicative goal (Table 2 ). Dataset construction retains or rewrites source material for these contexts, which are also provided in evaluation.
blocks.zh: 单是分类学标签并不能指定如何遇到消息,因为适当的支持也取决于表达危难的相互作用设置. 我们定义了四个应用背景,每个背景都包含一个互动合同,规定当事者的长度、结构、收件人和沟通目标(表2)。 数据集构建保留或重写这些背景的源材料,这些内容也在评价中提供.

blocks.en: 4 Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: 4 数据集建设

blocks.en: To evaluate responses across culturally situated expressions and application contexts, VEILED-SH leverages local forum material and public self-harm and suicide datasets. We screen sources, assign synthetic personas and application contexts, retain or rewrite prompts, and check the text before release. The design aims to preserve the source’s meaning and risk while varying how a user might present it. Figure 2 illustrates the construction, calibration, and evaluation flow. Appendix A.3 provides analyses of the constructed prompts.
blocks.zh: 为了评价在文化背景的表达和应用背景下的反应,VEILED-SH利用了地方论坛材料和公共自我伤害和自杀数据集。 我们筛选来源,分配合成人和应用上下文,保留或重写提示,并在发布前检查文本. 设计的目的是保留来源的含义和风险,同时改变用户如何表述。 图2显示施工、校准和评价流程。 附录A.3分析了已建的电路。

blocks.en: A source row is an ingested record; a retained row passes source filtering and becomes an input to prompt construction. Each retained row receives a synthetic persona and an application context from Section 3.2 to produce a constructed prompt . The persona varies expression without representing an author’s identity. Forum prompts retain source wording apart from anonymization; prompts for counselor chat, platform search, or triage are rewritten for that context.
blocks.zh: 一个源行是一个摄入的记录;一个保留行通过源过滤,成为快速构建的输入. 每个保留行都收到一个合成人a和第3.2节的应用程序上下文,以产生一个构造的提示。 个人的表达方式不同,但不代表作者的身份。 论坛提示除了匿名之外还保留源词;顾问聊天的提示,平台搜索,或分门别类的提示都为上下文重写.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of VEILED-SH construction.
blocks.zh: 图2:VEILED-SH建设概况.

blocks.en: 4.1 Source Collection and Ingestion
blocks.zh: 4.1 来源收集和摄入

blocks.en: Public posts from local community sources provide examples of culturally situated distress, coded language, and help-seeking conventions less visible in generic corpora. Five public self-harm and suicide datasets broaden the source material, listed in Table 6 . We screen source rows for mental-health relevance using regex retrieval and full-text classifiers, while retaining hard negatives and uncertain cases that do not contain explicit self-harm keywords. In the process, intermediate proxy labels were generated from the taxonomy in Section 3 to support filtering, sampling, and distribution checks, but were not kept for downstream evaluation.
blocks.zh: 来自当地社区的公职提供了文化背景困难、编码语言和寻求帮助的公约在通用公司中不太明显的例子。 5个公共自残和自杀数据集拓宽了来源材料,见表6. 我们使用regex检索器和全文分类器筛选与心理健康相关的源行,同时保留硬底片和未明确包含自伤害关键词的不确定案例. 在这一过程中,从第3节的分类学中生成了中间代理标签,以支持过滤、取样和分配检查,但并未保留用于下游评估。

blocks.en: Table 3: Transformation-evaluation dimensions.
blocks.zh: 表3:转型评价方面。

blocks.en: 4.2 Persona Routing
blocks.zh: 4.2 游行活动

blocks.en: Contextual rewriting requires variation in voice without treating source authors as known individuals. For each source row, an LLM proposes a synthetic author sketch and inferred constraints for age, sex, education level, marital status, and occupation. We embed the sketch and use cosine similarity to retrieve the ten most similar personas from NVIDIA’s public Nemotron-Personas-Singapore dataset ( Thongpramoon et al., 2026 ) . An LLM compares the source text with those candidates in similarity order and assigns the best-fitting persona.
blocks.zh: 背景重写需要语音变化而不将源作者视为已知个人. 对于每一行来源,一个LLM建议合成作者草图,并推断出年龄、性别、教育水平、婚姻状况和职业方面的限制。 我们嵌入了素描,并使用余弦相似性从NVIDIA的公众Nemotron-Personas-Singapore数据集(Thongpramoon等人,2026年)中获取十种最相似的人。 一个LLM以相似的顺序将源文本与这些候选文本进行比较,并指定最适合的人a.

blocks.en: The assigned persona guides the rewritten prompt’s age, background, voice, and speaking style, while the source text remains the basis for its meaning, emotional state, and risk severity.
blocks.zh: 指定人物a 引导重写提示的年龄、背景、声音和说话风格, 而源文本仍然是其意义、情感状态和风险严重性的基础。

blocks.en: 4.3 Contextual Transformation
blocks.zh: 4.3 背景转型

blocks.en: Forum posts meet one application context, so we retain a sample without rewriting. The sample is selected to match curation-stage label distributions. Other retained rows are assigned to counselor chat, platform search, or triage (Section 3.2 ) and rewritten for the corresponding interaction contract. Candidate rewriters receive the source text, assigned persona, and interaction contract. They are instructed to preserve meaning, facts, emotional direction, and risk while adapting voice and form to the context. Curated mental-health expressions from practitioners and local sources are provided as optional references when they fit the persona and context. Two authors independently reviewed 180 rewrites each, with 90 shared prompts. Sampling used equal proportions across the three rewritten contexts and three rewriter models. Weighted quality means were 4.13–4.41 out of 5. Weighted severity-preservation and leakage failure rates were 10.1% and 1.2% respectively (Appendix A.5 ).
blocks.zh: 论坛的帖子符合一个应用环境,所以我们保留一个样本而不重写. 选取样本是为了匹配曲艺阶段的标签分布. 其他保留行被分配到辅导员聊天,平台搜索或分门别类(第3.2节),并重写相应的互动合同. 候选人的改写稿获得源文本、指定人物和互动合同。 他们奉命维护意义、事实、情感方向和风险,同时使声音和形式适应环境。 实践者和地方来源的经验证的心理健康表达方式,在符合人名和上下文时作为可选参考。 两位作者分别独立审查180个重写,90个共享提示. 抽样在三个重写上下文和三个重写模型中采用了等比例. 加权质量手段为5.13-4.41。 重度防腐和漏泄故障率分别为10.1%和1.2%(附录A.5)。

blocks.en: Changing context can inadvertently amplify risk, erase crisis cues, or leave traces of the source platform. Rewrites are therefore evaluated by a construction judge using the eight dimensions in Table 3 : three eligibility gates for severity preservation, source leakage, and format compliance, and five graded quality measures. During development, we iteratively refined the construction judge over five diagnostic rounds to reduce false positives for leakage and severity preservation.
blocks.zh: 变化的背景可能会无意中扩大风险,抹去危机提示,或者留下源平台的痕迹. 因此,施工法官利用表3中的8个维度对重写进行评估:3个合格闸门,以保持严重程度、源渗漏和格式合规,以及5个分级的质量计量。 在开发期间,我们反复改进了建筑法官的五轮诊断,以减少渗漏和严重性保存方面的假阳性。

blocks.en: To encourage diversity in context transformations through differences in model rewriting styles, we evaluated 19 individual-model configurations and three fusion configurations (Table 7 ).
blocks.zh: 为了通过模型重写风格的不同来鼓励上下文转换的多样性,我们评价了19个个人模型配置和3个聚变配置(表7).

blocks.en:
Selection is gate-first: configurations are excluded if failure rates exceed 5% for severity preservation , 5% for source leakage , or 20% for format compliance . Thus, high quality scores cannot compensate for failures to preserve risk or produce usable text. Passing configurations are then ranked by transformation quality, Q = 0.25 ​ f + 0.25 ​ p + 0.20 ​ a + 0.20 ​ c + 0.10 ​ n Q=0.25f+0.25p+0.20a+0.20c+0.10n ,
combining factual fidelity ( f f ), persona fidelity ( p p ), style fit ( a a ), context fit ( c c ), and naturalness ( n n ).
blocks.zh:
选择为门-第一:如果故障率超过5%,则排除配置。 因此,高质量的评分不能弥补未能保持风险或产生可用文本。 通过配置后按变换质量排序,Q=0.25 f + 0.25 p + 0.20 a + 0.20 c + 0.10 n → 0.25 f+0.25p+ 0.20a+0.20c+0.10n ,
结合实际忠诚(f f ),人格忠诚(p ),风格适合(a ),上下文适合(c c),自然性(n n ).

blocks.en: Three models passed all quality gates. Detailed model-selection results and failure analysis are provided in Appendix A.2 . Non-forum rows receive seeded context assignments and round-robin rewrite assignments among the selected models. The resulting constructed population contains 10,438 prompts; its source and context counts are summarized in Table 4 .
blocks.zh: 三个模型都通过了质量门. 详细的模型选择结果和故障分析见附录A.2。 非论坛行接收种子上下文任务,并在选定的模型中重写圆形robin任务. 由此形成的建筑群包含10,438个急流;其来源和背景统计见表4。

blocks.en: Table 4: Constructed prompt counts before release exclusions. Source groups include public-dataset prompts identified by their source-case IDs.
blocks.zh: 表4:在释放排除之前推定的及时计数。 来源组包括由源码识别的公共数据集提示.

blocks.en: 4.4 Anonymization
blocks.zh: 4.4 匿名

blocks.en: Public availability does not eliminate identification risk in personal disclosures. We therefore apply the Cloak Anonymization Toolkit ( Government Technology Agency of Singapore, 2026 ) , developed for the Singapore context, for named-entity replacement, followed by literal and regex-based checks for residual identifiers. Appendix A.4 documents the anonymization chain.
blocks.zh: 公开发布并不能消除个人披露中的识别风险。 因此,我们采用为新加坡背景开发的Cloak匿名化工具包(新加坡政府技术局,2026年),用于命名实体的替换,然后对剩余识别资料进行文字和regex形式的检查。 附录A.4记录了匿名链。

blocks.en: 5 Plural-Reference Evaluation Framework
blocks.zh: 5 多参考评价框架

blocks.en: The plural-reference framework has three stages. Practitioners annotate a common calibration set using the taxonomy in Section 3 . We calibrate one automated profile per practitioner to generate separate reference policies for constructed prompts. This keeps differences between practitioner perspectives visible. A separate scoring pass compares system responses with each policy to produce proxy alignment analyses.
blocks.zh: 复数参考框架有三个阶段。 从业人员使用第3节中的分类法对一套通用校准进行注释。 我们校准每个从业人员一个自动剖面图,以便为已建的提示生成单独的参考政策。 这使从业者观点之间的差异得以显现。 单独的分数通过将系统响应与每项政策进行比较,以产生代理配对分析。

blocks.en: 5.1 Practitioner Annotation
blocks.zh: 5.1 从业人员说明

blocks.en: A practitioner annotation is a label supplied directly by a human practitioner. The calibration set comprises the same 30 cases for all six practitioners: three peer-support practitioners and three clinicians. Each case includes its application context, assigned persona, and transformed prompt, yielding 180 human-authored practitioner–case records. The small panel does not represent the full diversity of either responder archetype; researchers applying this workflow should collect appropriate expert annotations for their setting.
blocks.zh: 业者注解是人类业者直接提供的标签. 这套标准包括所有6名执业医师的同样30个病例:3名同伴支助执业医师和3名临床医生。 每个案例都包括其应用背景、指定人物a 和迅速转变,产生了180个由人类授权的从业人员-案例记录。 小型研究小组并不代表两个响应者都具有完全的多样性;应用这一工作流程的研究人员应收集适当的专家说明,说明其设置情况。

blocks.en: The six annotators were recruited voluntarily through the same professional networks as the participants in Section 3.1 .
blocks.zh: 这6名公证员是自愿通过与第3.1节参与者相同的专业网络招聘的。

blocks.en: Practitioners independently annotated the set through a web interface displaying each case’s context, persona, and prompt. They selected labels on INTENT , FUNCTION , and RESPONSE with notes to explain ambiguity and severity sublevels (Appendix B.1 ).
blocks.zh: 从业者通过显示每个案例的背景、人物和快速的网络界面,独立地对集进行注释。 他们选择了INTENT、FONUTION和RESPONSE上的标签,并附有说明,以解释模糊性和严重性(附录B.1 )。

blocks.en: Mean pairwise Jaccard across the complete multi-label records is 0.507 for peer-support practitioners and 0.545 for clinicians, indicating substantial practitioner disagreement (Appendix C.2 ).
blocks.zh: 在完整的多标签记录中,平均对等的Jaccard是同行支助从业人员的0.507,临床医生的0.545,表明执业人员存在重大分歧(附录C.2)。

blocks.en: 5.2 Automated Profile Calibration
blocks.zh: 5.2 自动剖面校准

blocks.en: The practitioner annotations cover only the calibration cases, so we use calibrated automated evaluators as scaling instruments to extend individual labeling patterns to the constructed prompts. We compare six methods separately for each responder archetype: a nearest-neighbor semantic-similarity floor (E0), zero-shot prompting (E1), few-shot prompting (E2), GEPA ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ) (E3), MemAlign ( The Mosaic Research Team, 2026 ) (E4), and cascaded MemAlign (E5). E0 provides a selection baseline for comparison. Shared defaults and method details appear in Appendix B.2 .
blocks.zh: 执业说明只涵盖校准案例,所以我们使用校准的自动评估器作为缩放仪器,将单个标签模式延伸至构造的提示. 我们分别比较了每个应答器型的6种方法:近邻语义-同位素底片(E0),零射提示(E1),几射提示(E2),GEPA(Agrawal等人,2026),(E3),MemAlign(Mosaic研究小组,2026),(E4)和级联MemAlign(E5). E0提供了比较的选择基线. 共享的默认和方法细节见附录B.2。

blocks.en: We evaluate each method by five-fold cross-validation over the 30 calibration cases. Each fixed fold uses 24 cases for calibration and six for held-out evaluation. We report supported-label macro-F1 using the first prediction for each held-out case, with each practitioner weighted equally within an archetype. For each responder archetype, we select the method that exceeds the E0 baseline by at least 0.03 macro-F1 with at least 80% paired-bootstrap probability of improvement.
blocks.zh: 我们通过对30个校准案例进行五倍的交叉校准来评估每种方法。 每个固定折叠采用24个病例进行校准,6个用于停产评价. 我们使用对每个被搁置的个案的第一个预测来报告支持的标签宏F1,每个执业者在原型内均匀加权。 对于每个响应器型号,我们选择超过E0基线至少0.03个宏-F1的方法,其中至少有80%的配对-bootstrap概率得到改进.

blocks.en:
Table 5: Evaluator selection by responder archetype.
Bold values indicate the selected methods for each archetype.
blocks.zh:
表5:按响应者类型分列的评估者选择。
粗体值表示每个型号的选定方法。

blocks.en:
Peer support selects E5 (0.687 macro-F1), while clinicians select E4 (0.704; Table 5 ). Mean pairwise Jaccard is a secondary check on how closely profile agreement resembles practitioner agreement. On the calibration set, the selected profiles yield Jaccard scores of 0.577 and 0.560 for peer support and clinicians respectively, compared with 0.507 and 0.545 for the original human annotations.
These results suggest that calibration partially preserves practitioner differences, although the 30 calibration cases provide limited evidence for reproducing judgments across the multi-label taxonomy. As a result, their outputs remain automated proxies rather than human judgments. Label distributions are in Appendix C .
blocks.zh:
同伴支持选择E5(0.687宏-F1),临床医生选择E4(0.704;表5 ). 平均对称的Jaccard是二级检查,检查配置协议与从业人员协议的相似程度。 在校准集上,所选的剖面图分别为同伴支持和临床医生的Jaccard分数0.577分和0.560分,而原始人类说明的分数分别为0.507分和0.545分.
这些结果表明,校准部分地保留了从业者的差异,尽管30个校准案例为跨多标签分类法复制判决提供了有限的证据。 因此,其产出仍然是自动代理而不是人力判断。 标签分发情况见附录C。

blocks.en: After method selection, the method is fit once per practitioner using the calibration set to form a practitioner profile: E5 for each peer supporter and E4 for each clinician. Each of the six profiles generates a reference policy for every constructed prompt.
blocks.zh: 经过方法选择后,该方法每从业者一次适合使用校准设置形成从业者简介:每对同伴支持者E5,每对临床医生E4. 6个剖面图中的每一个都为每个构建的快速生成一个参考政策.

blocks.en: To prevent calibration leakage, we exclude the 30 annotated prompts and 18 additional prompts sharing their original source-post identifiers. Although each source row produces one constructed prompt, multiple rows may originate from the same source post and appear in different application contexts. This yields 48 excluded prompts in total.
blocks.zh: 为了防止校准泄漏,我们排除了30个注解的提示和另外18个分享其原始源站标识符的提示. 虽然每个源行产生一个构造的即时,但多个行可能源于同一个源句,并出现在不同的应用上下文中. 这总共产生了48个排除的提示。

blocks.en: In addition to the 48 calibration set linked exclusions, 387 unique prompts were excluded due to failed interpretations or missing severity outputs across the six profiles. Removing these prompts yields 10,003 prompts with complete labels from all six profiles. Each released prompt includes metadata and six separate profile-generated label sets. These labels are neither human annotations nor human ground truth.
blocks.zh: 除了48个校准组连带排除外,还有387个独特的提示被排除在外,因为六个组合中的解释失败或严重性产出缺失。 删除这些提示后, 所有6个配置图中都有10 003个带有完整标签的提示 。 每个发布提示包括元数据和六个单独的配置文件生成的标签集. 这些标签既不是人的说明,也不是人底的真理.

blocks.en: 5.3 System Response Generation and Scoring
blocks.zh: 5.3 系统反应生成和计分

blocks.en: We evaluate five systems with distinct base models: GPT 5.6 Terra, Claude Sonnet 5, Grok 4.3, GLM 5.2, and DeepSeek V4 Pro. Each responds under peer-support and clinician instructions and is scored against the matching reference policies.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了五个具有不同基准模型的系统:GPT 5.6 Terra、Claude Sonnet 5、Grok 4.3、GLM 5.2和DeepSeek V4 Pro。 每一份都根据同行支助和临床医生的指示作出回应,并对照相应的参考政策进行评分。

blocks.en: All systems and responder archetypes use the same fixed diagnostic sample of 2,001 non-calibration prompts (approximately 20% of the release). We reserve examples at each NSSI and suicidal-intent severity level, then weight sampling toward uncommon contexts, sources, intents, and functions. Each system receives the responder-archetype and context instructions, persona background, and user input, and generates a user-facing response. Generation uses medium reasoning effort, a 1,024-token visible-output cap, and temperature 0 where exposed.
blocks.zh: 所有系统和应答器型都使用同样的固定诊断样本2,001个非校准提示(约占释放量的20%). 我们保留每个NSSI和自杀意图严重性层面的例子,然后根据不寻常的情况、来源、意图和功能进行加权抽样。 每个系统都接收响应器-archetype和上下文指示,人物背景,以及用户输入,并生成一个用户化的响应. 一代使用中等推理能力,1 024个托肯可见输出上限,接触温度0。

blocks.en: In a separate pass, a jury of Gemini-3.5-Flash, MiniMax M3, and Nemotron 3 Ultra scores each response against the corresponding profile-generated reference policy. These judges were selected to avoid direct model-family overlap with the five evaluated systems. Each judge receives the prompt, persona, application context, responder archetype, reference policy, and system response, and independently returns an appropriateness judgment, satisfied RESPONSE categories, and a rationale.
blocks.zh: 在一份单独的通行证中,由双子座3.5-Flash,MiniMax M3和Nemotron 3 Ultra组成的评审团根据相应的剖面生成的参考政策对每个响应进行评分. 挑选这些法官是为了避免与五个受评价的系统直接发生模式家庭重叠。 每位法官都收到即时、人称、应用程序背景、答复者原型、参考政策和系统反应,独立地返回适当的判断、满足答复和理由。

blocks.en: Normalized coverage is the fraction of policy RESPONSE categories judged satisfied. Proxy alignment is full if the response is appropriate and satisfies the entire policy, partial if it is appropriate and satisfies only a proper subset, and failed otherwise. We average judge-level results, preserving each judge’s contribution to the reported proxy-alignment estimates. Source-case-cluster bootstrap 95% intervals keep matched responses and all judge scores together. Normalized coverage makes policy-size differences visible but does not eliminate differences among reference policies.
blocks.zh: 正规化的覆盖率是评为满意的RESPONSE政策类别的一小部分。 如果反应是适当的,满足了整个政策,如果是适当的,只是满足了适当的子集,则代理对齐是完全的,否则就失败了。 我们平均法官一级的结果,保留每个法官对所报告的代理调整估计数的贡献。 95%的间隔保持对应的答复,所有评委都得分一致。 标准化的覆盖面使政策规模的差异明显可见,但并不能消除参考政策之间的差异。

blocks.en: The shared prompts and scoring contract support descriptive comparisons of proxy alignment. Although Gemini-3.5-Flash is used for both reference-policy generation and response scoring, it has no model-family overlap with the evaluated systems, and the three-judge jury reduces reliance on its judgments. Potential shared model assumptions remain a limitation. Appendix D.1 reports individual-judge results and robustness checks.
blocks.zh: 共享提示和评分合同支持对代理配对的描述性比较。 虽然双子座3.5-Flash既用于参考政策生成,也用于响应评分,但它与被评价的系统没有模型家庭重叠,由三位法官组成的陪审团减少对其判决的依赖. 可能的共同模式假设仍然是一个限制。 附录D.1报告了个别法官的结果和健全的核查。

blocks.en: 6 Evaluation Results
blocks.zh: 6. 评价结果

blocks.en: Figure 3: Mean full, partial, and failed proxy alignment across three response judges, by profile and system.
blocks.zh: 图3:按概况和系统分列的三位答复法官之间平均完全、部分和失败的代理调整。

blocks.en: Figure 3 shows broadly similar system ordering across profiles, with substantial variation in absolute proxy-alignment scores. Individual judges produce generally similar orderings, with small differences in close comparisons (Appendix D.1 ). For GPT 5.6 Terra, mean full alignment ranges from 64.8% to 90.5% across peer-support profiles and from 37.0% to 77.7% across clinician profiles. The broadly consistent system ordering across judges suggests that the observed patterns are not driven by a single response judge. The substantial variation in absolute scores across profiles shows that alignment depends on the selected reference policy. Reporting separate profiles therefore reveals differences that a single benchmark score would conceal. These descriptive results do not establish statistically reliable rankings. Appendix D.3 reports mean rates, source-case-cluster intervals, and normalized coverage.
blocks.zh: 图3显示整个配置图的系统顺序大致相似,绝对代理对齐分数差异很大。 个别法官制作的订单大致相似,在密切比较上差别不大(附录D.1 )。 就GPT 5.6 Terra而言,平均完全匹配率从64.8%到90.5%不等,从37.0%到77.7%不等。 法官之间广泛一致的系统订单表明,所观察到的模式并非由一名回应法官驱动。 各剖面图的绝对分数差别很大,表明调整取决于选定的参考政策。 因此,单独报告的情况表明,单一基准得分会掩盖不同之处。 这些描述性结果没有确定统计上可靠的排名。 附录D.3报告是指费率、源案件组间隔和正常覆盖范围。

blocks.en: Clinician profiles generally yield lower full but higher partial alignment (Figure 3 ). For C1, partial alignment accounts for 51%–60% of responses across systems, while 11%–13% fail. Responses are thus often judged appropriate but incomplete . C1 has the lowest full-alignment rate for every system under all three judges. This pattern may partly reflect differences in reference-policy size, with clinician profiles generally requesting more response categories (Tables 10 and 11 ). For GPT 5.6 Terra, the P2–P3 gap narrows from 25.7 percentage points in full alignment to 10.7 points in normalized coverage. These gaps show sensitivity to the all-category requirement. Policy composition and judge behavior may also contribute.
blocks.zh: 临床医生的剖面图一般能产生更低的完整但更高的部分对齐(图3 )。 对于C1,部分对齐占系统间回复的51~60%,而11~13%失败. 因此,答复往往被认为适当但不完整。 C1对所有三名法官的每个系统都实行最低的全面调整率。 这种模式可能部分反映了参考政策规模的差异,临床医生概况一般要求更多的答复类别(表10和表11)。 就GPT 5.6 Terra而言,P2-P3的差距从完全一致的25.7个百分点缩小到10.7个百分点的正常覆盖率。 这些差距表明了对所有类别要求的敏感性。 政策构成和判断行为也可能有所贡献。

blocks.en: Support / Validate is the most requested category, and is almost universally satisfied (90.5%–99.9%), while Clarify / Investigate is less consistently satisfied (60.0%–82.5%) (Appendix D.2 ). This suggests that the evaluated systems are more likely to provide supportive responses than other behaviors. However, categories such as De-escalate and Refuse to Engage are rarely requested (0.9%–6.6%), limiting reliable assessment of these behaviors. These findings may reflect the dataset’s composition and do not account for the safeguards present in deployed products. These results are diagnostic proxy scores. They do not estimate real-world product performance. Researchers should evaluate their own systems in their intended deployment contexts.
blocks.zh: 支持/验证是要求最多的类别,几乎普遍满意(90.5%–99.9%),而澄清/调查则不太一致满意(60.0%–82.5%)(附录D.2)。 这表明被评价的系统比其他行为更可能提供支持性响应. 然而,诸如降级和拒绝接触等类别很少被要求(0.9%+6.6%),限制了对这些行为的可靠评估。 这些调查结果可能反映数据集的构成,而不反映部署产品中的保障措施。 这些结果是诊断代理得分. 它们并不估计现实世界的产品性能。 研究人员应当根据预期部署情况评估自己的系统。

blocks.en: 7 Discussion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论情况

blocks.en: Variation across policies for fixed responses (Section 6 ) shows that proxy alignment depends on the selected reference policy. Reporting per profile makes this dependence visible. However, the profiles are automated proxies (Appendix C.2 ). Comparisons with human annotations are needed to distinguish practitioner perspectives from differences arising during automated scale-out.
blocks.zh: 固定反应政策之间的差异(第6节)表明,代理协调取决于选定的参考政策。 逐个报告就可看出这种依赖性。 不过,剖面图是自动代理(附录C.2 ). 需要与人的说明进行比较,以区分从业者的观点与自动扩大规模过程中产生的差异。

blocks.en: Full alignment requires an appropriate response satisfying the entire reference policy, while normalized coverage measures the fraction of requested categories satisfied. Substantial partial alignment and the narrower P2–P3 gap in normalized coverage demonstrate why these complementary metrics matter. Because policies vary in size and composition, full-alignment rates should be reported alongside partial alignment, normalized coverage, and policy size.
blocks.zh: 完全一致要求作出适当的反应,满足整个参考政策,而正常的覆盖范围则衡量所要求类别得到满足的一小部分。 相当程度的局部调整和P2-P3标准化覆盖面的缩小表明这些互补的衡量标准为何重要。 由于政策的规模和组成各不相同,因此在报告全面调整率的同时,还应报告部分调整率、正常覆盖率和政策规模。

blocks.en: Evaluating individual response behaviors reveals gaps that overall alignment scores hide. For instance, responses that satisfy Support / Validate may still fail to Clarify / Investigate when needed (Section 6 ). Separating RESPONSE behaviors from prompt INTENT and FUNCTION enables this analysis, but increases annotation and evaluation complexity, particularly for categories with limited data. Subsequent studies can adapt contexts and policy scope to their application needs, though the mapping to the original taxonomy should be documented and scores should not be compared directly with those from the unmodified benchmark.
blocks.zh: 对个人反应行为的评价揭示了总体对齐分数隐藏的差距. 例如,满足支助/验证要求的对策可能仍然无法在必要时澄清/调查(第6节)。 将应急反应行为与快速INTENT和FONUION分开,可以进行这种分析,但增加了注释和评价的复杂性,特别是对数据有限的类别而言。 之后的研究可以使背景和政策范围适应其应用需要,尽管应该记录与原始分类学的映射,并且不应直接将分数与未修改基准的分数进行比较.

blocks.en: The five-system study demonstrates the workflow on a coverage-enriched subset, but does not establish clinical safety or reliable rankings. Practitioner ratings of responses are needed to assess the judge, alongside case-level comparisons of practitioner annotations and profile-generated policies. They should precede deployment-oriented claims in the intended application context.
blocks.zh: 五系统研究在覆盖范围丰富的子集上展示了工作流程,但没有建立临床安全性或可靠的排名. 需要从业者对答复进行评级,以评估法官,同时对从业者说明和概况生成的政策进行案例一级的比较。 在预期的应用情况下,应先于以部署为导向的索偿要求。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: VEILED-SH benchmarks single-turn responses to indirect, culturally situated expressions of suicide, self-harm, and distress and provides a dataset-construction pipeline. Its 10,003 prompts from Singapore-grounded sources and public datasets span four application contexts. An expert-validated multi-label taxonomy separates prompt interpretation from recommended response behavior; six practitioner-calibrated profiles generate reference policies for two responder archetypes. Five systems show policy-dependent proxy scores for fixed responses, with the main comparisons stable across three response judges. Practitioner scoring remains necessary before clinical safety claims.
blocks.zh: VEILED-SH基准对间接的、文化背景的自杀、自我伤害和痛苦等表达方式的单回合反应,并提供数据集构建管道。 其10 003个来自新加坡的源头和公共数据集的提示涉及四个应用背景。 一个经专家验证的多标签分类法将快速解释与建议的反应行为区分开来;六个实践者校准的剖面为两种反应者型号生成参考政策. 五个系统对固定答复显示政策依赖的代理分数,主要比较在三个答复法官中保持稳定。 在提出临床安全要求之前,从业人员评分仍有必要。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: The six profiles are calibrated on the same 30 cases annotated by six practitioners (180 practitioner–case records), a small basis for the multi-label taxonomy. The selected peer-support and clinician evaluators reach 0.687 and 0.704 out-of-fold macro-F1, respectively; rare-label fidelity remains uncertain, and scale-out only partly preserves observed practitioner disagreement (Appendix C.2 ). Profile-generated policies are therefore proxies, not additional human judgments. Larger and more diverse practitioner panels, alongside additional calibration cases, could improve coverage and support more reliable assessment of rare labels.
blocks.zh: 这6个简介是根据6名从业人员注释的同样30个案例(180名从业人员-案例记录)校准的,这是多标签分类学的一个小基础。 选定的同行支助和临床评估人员分别达到0.687和0.704倍的宏观F1;稀有标签的忠诚度仍然不确定,扩大规模只能部分保留所观察到的从业者分歧(附录C.2)。 因此,概况产生的政策是代理政策,而不是额外的人类判断。 更大和更多样化的执业小组,加上更多的校准案例,可以扩大覆盖面并支持对稀有标签进行更可靠的评估。

blocks.en: Contextual rewrites may introduce unsupported local cues or stereotypes. The author review yielded high mean quality ratings but limited inter-rater agreement, and does not establish cultural authenticity across the full dataset. Persona constraints remain synthetic rather than verified attributes of source authors. The 2,001-prompt diagnostic sample increases coverage of less frequent cases and does not estimate population prevalence. Even there, some requested RESPONSE categories remain rare: among 6,003 profile policies per archetype, refusal appears in 55 peer-support and 316 clinician policies. Category-level estimates for such behaviors are uncertain.
blocks.zh: 背景重写可能会引入无支持的本地提示或刻板印象. 作者的审阅获得了高中度质量评分,但评分之间协议有限,没有在整个数据集中确立文化真实性。 人的限制仍然是合成的,而不是经核实的来源作者的属性。 2 001个即时诊断样本扩大了发病率较低的病例的覆盖面,没有估计人口流行率。 即使在那里,一些所要求的答复类别仍然很少:在按原型划分的6 003项概况政策中,拒绝出现在55项同行支助和316项临床医生政策中。 此类行为的类别级估计不确定。

blocks.en: The study covers peer-support and clinician archetypes, single-turn responses, and five general-purpose LLM systems.
blocks.zh: 该研究涉及同行支持和临床医生的型号、单回合反应和五个通用LLM系统。

blocks.en: Other responder perspectives may yield different interpretations and response policies, hence the framework can be adapted by calibrating profiles using annotations from practitioners relevant to the intended application.
blocks.zh: 其他答复者的观点可能会产生不同的解释和反应政策,因此可以通过使用与预期应用相关的从业人员的说明来校准简介来调整框架。

blocks.en: Single-turn evaluation reflects settings such as forum posts, search queries, and triage interactions, but does not capture evolving risks in multi-turn conversations. Nonetheless, the benchmark preserves structured information that enables extension to multi-turn simulations without reconstructing the underlying prompt set.
blocks.zh: 单回合评价反映了论坛帖子,搜索查询,分门别类互动等环境,但没有在多回合对话中抓住不断变化的风险. 尽管如此,该基准保留了结构化信息,使得能够扩展至多回合模拟,而无需重建基本的快速集。

blocks.en: The system evaluations serve as a demonstration of the proposed methodology and not a definitive comparison of model capabilities. Unlike deployed products, the evaluated systems do not incorporate application-specific safeguards, crisis routing, or escalation mechanisms, which may affect response behavior. Furthermore, exact evaluated-system endpoint IDs are not reported, and reproducing specific outputs may be challenging due to the evolving nature of some closed-source systems. We therefore encourage teams to apply the documented methodology to their own target systems and contexts.
blocks.zh: 系统评价是拟议方法的证明,而不是模型能力的明确比较。 与部署的产品不同,被评价的系统没有包含针对应用的保障措施,危机路径,或升级机制,这可能影响到反应行为. 此外,准确的系统评价终点 身份证没有报告,由于一些封闭源码系统性质不断变化,复制具体产出可能具有挑战性。 因此,我们鼓励各小组对自己的目标系统和情况采用有文件记载的方法。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: The practitioner discussions and annotation sessions exposed practitioners to public posts about distress, self-harm, and suicide. Participants were informed in advance; sessions were bounded, and they could skip cases or withdraw without penalty. Debriefing was offered, and participants were compensated in accordance with institutional participant-compensation guidelines. Exact compensation amounts are not disclosed. Profiles are calibrated evaluators, not psychological models of practitioners. Only neutral aliases identify profiles in the release; identity mappings, raw practitioner labels, free-text rationales, and private memories are excluded from the release.
blocks.zh: 执业者的讨论和注释会让执业者在公共职位上暴露出关于危难、自我伤害和自杀的印象。 事先通知了与会者;会议是限定的,他们可以跳过案件,也可以不处罚地退出。 提供了简报,并按照机构参与者补偿准则向与会者提供补偿。 确切的赔偿数额不予披露。 简介是校准的评估者,而不是从业者的心理模型. 只有中性化名在发行中识别剖面图;身份映射,原始从业者标签,自由文本理由,以及私人记忆被排除在发行之外.

blocks.en: Public accessibility does not remove privacy or search-based re-identification risk, particularly for forum prompts that retain source wording apart from anonymization. The anonymization chain replaces detected identifiers, but cannot guarantee de-identification; it also restores public-dataset rows assumed to have been de-identified upstream (Appendix A.4 ). We do not attempt to identify or contact source authors.
blocks.zh: 公众可获取性并不能消除隐私或基于搜索的重新识别风险,特别是对于除了匿名之外保留源词的论坛提示。 匿名链取代了检测到的标识符,但不能保证去识别;它还恢复了公用数据集的行,假定这些行已被去识别的上游(Appendix A.4 . 我们没有试图识别或联系来源作者。

blocks.en: The release will provide prompts, contexts, personas, and six profile-generated reference policies, while private source material and practitioner records will be withheld. Access conditions will prohibit identification or surveillance, but cannot eliminate misuse against vulnerable people. The collection protocol was reviewed by the relevant institutional ethics body and determined to be exempt from formal ethics review.

blocks.en: Practitioners received the following text: Based on the context, a persona, and their message, label three things: INTENT (what they’re going through), FUNCTION (why is the user saying this), and RESPONSE (how should an AI respond). There’s no right answer. These cases are hard to categorize and depend heavily on context. We want to understand how different responder archetypes would react to different vulnerable groups across different contexts. We expect annotators to disagree, and that disagreement is the signal we’re after. Please answer as honestly and in as much detail as possible. If anything feels ambiguous or you’re torn between labels, add it to the notes. blocks.en: C.2 Profile Agreement
blocks.zh: C.2 概况协定

blocks.en: Tables 12 and 13 compare agreement among practitioner annotations on the calibration set with agreement among profile-generated labels on the full constructed dataset. Per-label AC1 2 2 2 Gwet’s AC1 is a chance-corrected agreement coefficient that remains stable when a label is skewed. is computed from binary label presence or absence. A higher value means more agreement for that label. Mean pairwise Jaccard gives a complementary measure of overlap between complete label sets.
blocks.zh: 表12和表13比较了从业人员对校准集的说明与全构数据集配置图生成的标签之间的一致。 Per-label AC1 2 2 2 Gwet的AC1是一个偶然修正的协议系数,当标签被扭曲时,这个系数保持稳定. 从二进制标签存在或缺失中计算。 更高的价值意味着更同意这个标签。 平均对称的Jaccard给出了完整标签套件之间重叠的辅助度量.

blocks.en: Agreement varies by label. Both responder archetypes have high agreement for suicidal intent (AC1 = 0.898), while peer-support practitioners have low agreement for provide advice (0.069) and redirect (0.231). Clinicians have lower agreement at the emotional-distress boundary (INTENT_1, 0.248) and for provide advice (0.349). These results show that disagreement concerns both prompt interpretation and the preferred response.
blocks.zh: 协议因标签而异。 两种反应者型号都高度认同自杀意图(AC1 = 0.898),而同行支助从业人员对提供咨询(0.069)和重定向(0.231)的认同度较低。 临床医生在情绪-沉淀边界(INTENT_1,0.248)和提供建议(0.349)方面有较低的共识. 这些结果表明,分歧既涉及迅速解释,也涉及首选的反应。

blocks.en: Table 12: Peer-support per-label AC1 for practitioner annotations and scaled profile-generated labels.
blocks.zh: 表12:同行支持/标签AC1用于从业人员说明和缩放配置生成的标签.

blocks.en: Table 13: Clinician per-label AC1 for practitioner annotations and scaled profile-generated labels.
blocks.zh: 表13:临床医生每标签AC1用于执业说明和缩放的剖面生成标签.

blocks.en: The profile-generated labels retain some differences between profiles. Mean pairwise Jaccard increases from 0.507 to 0.593 for peer support and from 0.545 to 0.584 for clinicians, suggesting greater agreement among the profile-generated labels, although the statistics are computed on different prompt populations. Peer provide advice AC1 rises from 0.069 in human annotations to 0.433 in proxies, and clinician support and validate rises from 0.446 to 0.686. Other categories remain more variable, such as clarify/investigate in both roles (proxy AC1 of 0.298 and 0.263). Disagreement preservation is therefore partial; scale-out does not faithfully reproduce every human pattern.
blocks.zh: 配置文件生成的标签保留了配置文件之间的一些差异. 平均对称的Jaccard同龄人支助从0.507增加到0.593,临床医生从0.545增加到0.584,这表明在剖面图生成的标签之间有更大的一致,尽管统计数字是根据不同的快速人群计算的。 同行提供咨询AC1从人类注解的0.069上升到代言的0.433,临床医生的支持和鉴定从0.446上升到0.686。 其他类别仍然比较多变,例如澄清/调查这两个角色(副AC1,0.298和0.263)。 因此,分歧保留是局部的;扩大规模并不能忠实地复制每一个人类模式。

blocks.en: Appendix D Additional System-Evaluation Analyses
blocks.zh: 附录D 系统评估分析

blocks.en: D.1 Response-Judge Robustness
blocks.zh: D.1 反应能力-法官

blocks.en: All three judges score the same responses against the same profile-specific reference policies on 2,001 prompts. We average judge outcome rates and normalized coverage equally within each profile and compute confidence intervals by source-case bootstrap with seed 12345, keeping matched judgments together. These intervals describe sampling uncertainty conditional on the fixed judges and reference policies.
blocks.zh: 所有这三名法官在2 001个评分中,都对相同的概况参考政策作出同样的评分。 我们平均判断结果率和每个剖面的正常覆盖率,并用12345种种子按源码计算信任间隔,使判断一致。 这些间隔描述了以固定法官和参考政策为条件的抽样不确定性。

blocks.en: Figure 8 shows the individual-judge results. The spread between judges’ full-alignment rates ranges from 0.5 to 7.8 percentage points across the 30 system–profile combinations. Table 14 reports exact agreement on the full, partial, or failed class. Agreement measures consistency between judges.
blocks.zh: 图8显示了个别法官的结果。 法官全校比例之间的差幅在30个系统组合的0.5至7.8个百分点之间。 表14报告了关于全部、部分或失败类别的确切协议。 协议衡量法官之间的一致性。

blocks.zh: 表14:法官就全系统组合的一致级别(百分比)达成协议的范围。

blocks.en: To test the sensitivity of individual judges, we remove each judge in turn and compare the remaining two-judge mean with the full jury mean. Full proxy alignment changes by at most 2.13 points, and system ordering remains broadly similar. Individual judges show some differences, with MiniMax ranking DeepSeek above Grok under several profiles. These results suggest that the broad descriptive patterns are relatively insensitive to the choice of response judge within this jury. Agreement among automated judges does not establish agreement with human response-level assessments.
blocks.zh: 为了检验个别法官的敏感性,我们依次罢免每位法官,并将剩下的两名法官的恶性与陪审团的恶性进行比较。 完全代理对齐在最多2.13点时变化,系统订购仍然大致相似. 个别评委表现出一些差异,在几个简介下,MiniMax将DeepSeek排在格罗克之上. 这些结果表明,广义的描述模式相对而言对这个陪审团内的反应法官的选择不敏感。 自动化法官之间的协议并不与人类反应评估建立协议.

blocks.en: D.4 Context Alignment
blocks.zh: D.4 背景调整

blocks.en: Figure 9 shows mean proxy alignment across the three judges. Scores vary more across systems in the three transformed contexts than for retained forum posts. One possible explanation is that contextual transformations introduce stylistic regularities that influence the model alignment with automated reference policies. However, differences in source composition, severity, and policy distributions may also contribute, so this pattern cannot be attributed to transformation alone.
blocks.zh: 图9显示三名法官之间的代理关系。 在三个转变背景下,各系统得分的差异大于保留论坛员额。 一种可能的解释是,背景转变引入了影响模型与自动参考政策保持一致的语境规律。 然而,来源组成、严重程度和政策分布方面的差异也可能助长这种情况,因此,这种模式不能仅仅归因于转变。

blocks.en: Figure 9: Mean proxy alignment across three judges by system and context. Each archetype pools its three profiles and uses different response texts.
blocks.zh: 图9:按系统和背景分列的三名法官的平均代理配比。 每种原型都汇集其三个简介,并使用不同的响应文本.

blocks.en: D.5 Severity Alignment
blocks.zh: D.5 高度对齐

blocks.en: Figure 10 shows mean full proxy alignment across the three judges by NSSI and suicidal-intent severity. Clinician scores generally decline as suicidal-intent severity rises, while peer-support patterns vary by system. Claude Sonnet 5 exceeds GPT 5.6 Terra at suicidal-intent levels 4 and 5 in both archetypes, showing that system ordering also depends on severity. These trends are descriptive because some severity groups contain few cases.
blocks.zh: 图10显示的是,按NSSI和自杀意图的严重程度,三名法官之间的代理完全一致。 临床医生的得分一般会随着自杀倾向的严重程度上升而下降,而同伴支持模式则因系统而异. Claude Sonnet 5 超过 GBT 5.6 两种类型中4级和5级自杀未遂的地面,表明系统订购也取决于严重程度。 这些趋势是描述性的,因为一些严重程度群体包含的案件很少。

blocks.en: Figure 10: Mean full proxy alignment across three judges by severity. Archetypes pool profiles and use different response texts. Cases with both severities use suicidal severity.
blocks.zh: 图10:按严重程度对三名法官进行平均完全代理调整。 考古类型集合简介并使用不同的响应文本. 两者兼具的病例都具有自杀严重性。
